contract: Controlled selection,count,durationMillis,paused and contextKey. Source5dp inactive dots,20dp active capsule,5dp spacing,10dp overall height and300ms width transition. Active fill advances over host duration; source pause collapses active capsule and shows full dot,then resets countdown on resume. Android lifecycle below RESUMED also pauses and resets. Callback emits one next-index request per selection interval; host must update selection to continue. Wraps last page to zero; empty/singleton counts never request. Context/duration/count/selection changes cancel prior timer. Source frame-clock timing is deterministic in host tests. Gallery uses original5colors,220dp pages and2second timer; its settled-page synchronization may add page-settle delay relative to source. Swift spring,gradients,exact page-snap timing and physical/iOS motion/pixel comparison remain unverified.
remaining: Exact source springs/materials/fonts/symbols and physical/iOS paired motion/pixel comparison
